headline: NXP authors report reusing AMS verification tests in post-silicon validation
fact: An NXP-authored paper reports reusing pre-silicon AMS functional tests in post-silicon validation with matching stimulus timing and side-by-side waveform visualization. The methodology uses Jupyter and Python around a reusable environment for product variants; the authors report deployment across multiple projects and products and one-day silicon bring-up.

sources.title: Analog Mixed Signal Verification and Validation Methodology: Bridging Pre- and Post-Silicon
sources.summary: 2024 NXP paper on reusable AMS tests, Python/Jupyter orchestration, product variants, and pre- to post-silicon correlation.
